migration.description: Add durable metadata for original conversation artifacts while storing their bytes in a dedicated file volume.

durable_state.description: Original artifact bytes survive process restart in a dedicated object directory; PostgreSQL retains the artifact identity, session/run association, content type, size, SHA-256 and creation time.
durable_state.storage_implementation: PostgreSQL metadata managed by the embedded Goose migration and immutable files below a configured dedicated artifact root.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_version: Phase-one candidate before migration 00007; no earlier artifact metadata or file-volume state is supported.
source_compatibility_range.earlier_state: The absent table is treated as an unapplied migration; the candidate is not ready until migration 00007 commits. Session/project foreign keys are deferred until the P01 schema is published.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Create conversation_artifacts metadata with validated identifiers, associations, immutable content metadata and session/run lookup indexes.

progress_signals: Goose records migration 00007 before artifact metadata is read or written.
A successful upload reports the persisted metadata only after the staged file is hashed, synced and linked into the object directory.
Open verifies the stored file size and SHA-256 before returning a reader.
pause_points: After the metadata migration commits and before the Server or Connector mounts the artifact service.
After each staged file has passed size/hash validation and before metadata is committed.

recovery.faulty_release_recovery: forward-repair-by-a-new-program-version-and-new-ordered-migration; incomplete staging files remain inaccessible and failed uploads remove their staging file

required_test_evidence: A permitted Put persists original bytes and metadata, and Metadata/Open remain available after database close and reopen.
Size and SHA-256 mismatches, interrupted readers, malformed identifiers, traversal/symlink paths and unauthorized operations are rejected without exposing host paths or partial metadata.
R02 basic and unknown fixture content retains its raw envelope/payload and remains a non-executing classification fallback.
Migration 00007 is recognized idempotently and is not automatically reversed; P01 session/project foreign keys are added only by a later ordered migration after their schema exists.
